title: Mobile-responsive layout: Next Pieces panel above game board

requirements.text: Move the Next Pieces panel (NextPiecePreview) from the side column to above the game board in GameBoard.tsx. On mobile/small screens the panel should appear horizontally centered above the canvas, and on larger screens it may remain in its current sidebar position or also stay above — whichever keeps the layout clean and non-overlapping.

quotes: Sıradaki taşlar yanda değil oyunun üstünde olsun ekran
Sıradaki taşlar paneli oyun alanının üstüne taşınıyor

acceptanceCriteria: The Next Pieces panel is rendered above the game canvas, not to the side, on mobile viewports (≤640px width).
The Next Pieces panel does not overlap the game board or touch controls at any screen size.
On larger screens the layout remains visually balanced and the panel is still accessible.

requirements.text: Make the entire game screen layout (GameBoard.tsx and its children: GameCanvas, NextPiecePreview, TouchControlButtons, stats panels) fully responsive for small/vertical mobile screens. The game board must scale down to fit within the viewport height and width without horizontal or vertical overflow. Use viewport-relative sizing and CSS constraints to prevent the canvas from exceeding screen bounds.

quotes: Oyun özellikle mobil cihazlarda ekrana sığsın
Tüm ekranlar küçük/dikey mobil ekranlara tam uyumlu hale getiriliyor

acceptanceCriteria: On a 375×667px viewport (iPhone SE), the game board, next pieces panel, stats, and touch controls all fit on screen with no scrolling required.
The game canvas scales proportionally so it never exceeds the available viewport width or height.
No horizontal scrollbar appears on any mobile screen width from 320px upward.
Touch control buttons remain fully visible and do not overlap the game board.
All existing features (game modes, themes, audio, i18n) continue to function correctly after layout changes.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not alter game logic, scoring, audio, i18n, or theme behavior — only layout and responsive styling should change.
Keep frontend/public/app-ads.txt and LandingPage.tsx intact and unmodified.
Do not add or re-introduce PWA manifest or service worker registration.
nonGoals: Changing any game mechanics, rules, or scoring logic.
Modifying backend logic or data models.
Adding new game modes, themes, or languages.
Altering the Header, Footer, MainMenu, Leaderboard, MissionsPanel, or SettingsPanel layouts (unless they also overflow on mobile, in which case only fix overflow).
